news.notes: Neither team held a morning skate after each played Saturday. Korchinski likely replaces Kaiser, a defenseman who has a hearing with the NHL Department of Player Safety on Sunday after being assessed a match penalty and game misconduct for an illegal check to the head of Martin Pospisil in the second period of a 4-3 overtime win at the Calgary Flames on Saturday. … Frondell, a center, did not play the third period, and Blackhawks coach Jeff Blashill said after the game he wasn’t sure if he would play. … Toninato was recalled from Rockford of the American Hockey League, and Greenway, a forward, could also play after being scratched four games. … Commesso is expected to make his first start since being recalled from Rockford on Nov. 8. … Pettersson, a center, is day to day after missing the game Saturday. … Crotty, a defenseman, could replace Schenn, who played for the first time in five games against Minnesota.
